'''DecipherCon 1999 No Such Thing As Luck''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Steven Turner]] won, out of 18 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw12_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: No Such Thing As Luck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231735/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (No Such Thing As Luck)
* '''Format:''' [[No Such Thing As Luck]]<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Friday 12 November 1999, 6 p.m.–12 a.m.; Saturday 13 November 1999, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Players:''' 18 (Friday heat)

A Saturday heat is on the schedule. A Saturday score sheet is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
